urlPolicyProbe.method: Deterministic, no random seed. Each of 45 separators inserted at every position of each of 13 initial URL strings; Set removes duplicates. Four sanitizeUrl policies; nonempty parseable outputs compared with WHATWG URL protocols and HTTP(S) credentials.
limitations: Empty sanitizer results and URL parse failures were skipped, without separate counters.
This is not an HTML parser or HTML entity decoding test.
The protocol-level oracle does not separately validate data/blob payload contents.

focusInventoryRegistration.scope: actual full-page registration only; native case bodies not executed

dependencyAdvisoryReview.scope: Bounded review of primary published advisories for three runtime dependencies; not a complete npm audit or a full transitive dependency database review.

crossChecks.note: Release confirms all three October 2026 fixes despite stale narrative text in one advisory.
JSZip dist bundle fix landed in 3.7.1; installed 3.10.1 is later. Existence of 3.10.2 is not itself a security finding.

ciInstallAudit.limitations: Installation summary only; no separate npm audit --json response was collected. This is an advisory-registry snapshot, not proof of absence of all vulnerabilities.
